_avail.description: 8-button control pad with Ethernet, 1 bidirectional RS-232 port, 1 unidirectional RS-232 port, 3 GPIO; US, white
_avail.notes: [AVAIL] from Biamp documentation (as Impera Echo; Echo Plus figure not published separately)
_avail.portsMissing: NEB bus connector type is not stated.

ports.label: LAN
ports.notes: 10/100 Mbps; LAN control of up to 2 third-party devices

ports.label: RS-232/IR
ports.notes: 2-pin screw block (TX-2, GND): one-way RS-232 or IR, up to 2 IR emitters

ports.label: I/O 1-3
ports.notes: 4-pin screw block (I/O 1-3, GND); open drain, 24 V DC, 0.5 A max

ports.label: NEB
ports.notes: NEB extension bus (PWR, NDA, NCL, GND), up to 2 devices; 12 V DC 0.3 A output; connector type not stated

ports.label: Mini USB
ports.notes: Mini USB B 5P, programming; behind the front cover

ports.label: Power
ports.notes: 12 V DC, 2-pin screw block; included 100-240 V AC wall plug PSU
